home.premiumUIText: Custom GSAP (ScrollTrigger, Timeline) for smooth, non-intrusive interactions that guide attention.

home.clientsTask:
Create a minimalist and clean Landing Page to showcase a premium wireless speaker and its features. 
 The focus should be on clean typography, premium visuals, and plenty of whitespace to engage users.
home.devText:
Got it! 
 I will focus on pixel-perfect implementation, fully optimized premium visuals, and a flawless responsive layout across all devices.
home.clientsReaction: Exceeded our expectations! Fast, responsive, and beautifully animated. Will definitely work together again.
home.stepSubtitle1: Deep discovery — goals, audience, constraints, success metrics. We agree on scope before a single line of code.

home.stepSubtitle3: Cinematic motion, scroll-driven storytelling, and micro-interactions that make the product feel alive.
home.stepSubtitle4: Lighthouse 100s Fine-tuning the code for maximum speed. This includes fast image loading, code-splitting, and modern SSR/ISR setups.
